0022600177.text: The Bulls (1-6, on a five-game losing streak) visit the Knicks (3-4) for their eighth game of the season, with Chicago 1-4 on the road, 0-2 at home, 13th in the East, and fourth in the Central, five games back. New York is 2-2 at home, has won its last game, and sits eighth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic. The teams last met October 28 in Chicago, where the Bulls lost 133-127, and Chicago trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 1-3 to New York in 2025-26; Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury, and Jalen Smith is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision.
